marta: Heads up — prospective customer wants Private deployment with HSM keywrap for GA. Need to align product/eng/runtime/infra/security on launch gates + fallback options. Can we triage resourcing?
liam: @marta runtime can support Private if we reserve 2 GPUs per cluster and validate KV cache behavior. capacity is tight though — Q2 commitments already booked.
Drew: Security: HSM integration + threat model signoff looks like ~3 sprints. If we default to customer-managed keys via KMS (our VPC), that drops integration time to ~1 sprint but we need a documented risk acceptance.
sophia: Networking/VPC peering + routes take ~1 week after we get customer IP ranges. Also need egress cost estimate — who owns that with sales?
marta: Proposed launch gates: 1) Security signoff (or documented KMS risk acceptance), 2) infra networking validated, 3) Dedicated capacity reserved and perf smoke pass. If HSM not ready, fallback = KMS customer-managed keys + encryption-at-rest. @Drew ok with fallback conditional?
Drew: KMS fallback acceptable for GA if we produce an explicit mitigation doc and a compensating control (auditable key rotation + usage logs). I'll own scheduling the security review — Tue next week. We need a named owner to draft the mitigation doc.
liam: I can draft the risk/mitigation doc + perf test plan. I'll include a perf checklist: KV cache warmup, prefix caching, cold-start latency, and multi-tenant isolation checks. Target Thu EOD.
sophia: I can run a perf sweep Wed morning against a staging cluster (2x GPUs). Will also validate network egress numbers and add notes to the rollout checklist.
marta: Great. I'll confirm capacity ask with Sales/CS by Fri. If any item slips >1 week we push GA. Add rollout policy: canary in staging -> canary in prod (5%) -> full. deploy-bot: scheduled canary window: staging 03/12 09:00-12:00 UTC, prod canary pending staging pass.
marta: Action summary: liam = risk+perf doc (Thu EOD), sophia = perf run Wed AM, drew = security review Tue, marta = capacity commit with Sales by Fri. If blockers surface, escalate to exec oncall. :spiral_calendar: :thumbsup:
